During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''campaign''' was waged by the [[Empire Reborn]] against the [[New Jedi Order]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

==History==
===Prelude===
The [[Empire Reborn]] was a splinter group of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hethrir]], with Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Galak Fyyar]] having the responsibility of consolidating Empire Reborn build-up in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Fyyar allied with the [[Chistori]] [[Desann]], a rogue [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], who was once a fledgling initiate of the [[New Jedi Order]], until he was expelled by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] from the [[Jedi Praxeum]]. The two joined forces with the common goal of destroying the New Jedi Order.

In time, Hethrir tasked Desann with training several of his [[Empire Youth]]s: [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals who had shown devotion to the Empire Reborn and had been "purified" by the extradimensional being, [[Waru]]. Desann evetnually took one of the Youths, [[Tavion Axmis]], as his apprentice.<ref name="DFS6">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050616a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 6: Outcasts and Megalomaniacs Welcome}}</ref>

===The Reborn===
On a possibly related side, the derelict [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] around the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] were stripped from [[hull/Legends|armor]], [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]s, and [[power core/Legends|power core]]s; this was discovered by a New Republic contractor who came later for the same job; although the [[Chief of Security/Legends|security chief]] on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] did not speculate on the salvagers, it is possible that the components went for the Reborn forces, as the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] classified the report along with other relevant ones.<ref name="NRIR" />

The Rerborn's takeover of Bespin came one step closer when [[Reelo Baruk's Garbage Processing Facility|the company]] of Reelo Baruk won a contract to handle garbage hauling and disposal for all of Cloud City.<ref name="NRIR" /> His actual role was supplying the Empire Reborn with [[cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] and thugs for a [[Battle of Bespin (Empire Reborn)|takeover]] of the [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbonite freezing chambers]].<ref name="Jedi Outcast" /> [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] complained to the Senate about criminal syndicate activities in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="NRIR" />

Another alerting event was when a [[freighter/Legends|cargo ship]] bound for [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], refuelled on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], when its load of [[DXR-6 disruptor rifle]]s disappeared. N.R.I. was puzzled about the ship's business, who took the rifles, and why no official complaints were registered.<ref name="NRIR" />

In addition to training those with talent, Desann experimented with imbuing Force-weak [[Human/Legends|Human]] Empire Youths with dark side powers, using [[Artusian crystal]]s and [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemical]] secrets.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" /> A large deposit of such crystals was reported to be found by the [[Artus Prime Mining Facility|mining facility]] on [[Artus Prime]].<ref name="NRIR" /> Fyyar had [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] forces captured the facility in order to obtain [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Artusian crystal]]s. Most of the miners were imprisoned while others were transported to [[Kejim]].<ref name="Jedi Outcast" /> The remnant also apparently intercepted the Republic ship that was sent to Artus Prime.<ref name="NRIR" /> 

The Empire Reborn also restored the abandoned<ref name="NRIR" /> [[Kejim Outpost]] which was used to perform experiments on the crystals and the captured miners as test subjects. Their objective was to artificially infuse select [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] with [[the Force/Legends|the Force]] resulting in the [[Reborn]]. The outpost was commanded by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Stavan]] under orders from Fyyar.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" /> The Reborn operated a recruiting station on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] under orders from [[Kejim]] although they were entrusted with little information.<ref name="NRIR" />

The [[Cairn Installation]] housed cortosis-processing facilities for [[shadowtrooper]]s, and [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]] which Fyyar planned to launch against the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Jedi Outcast" /> 

===Investigation===
In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] The [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] was alerted when they spotted a [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|Sentinel-class landing craft]] near [[Cairn]] and began investigation into the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] concerning [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Blitzer Harrsk|Horrsk's]] activities there, while requesting a list of unaccounted ''Sentinel''s and their known owners.<ref name="NRIR" /> 

An [[agent/Legends|agent]] stationed on [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] alerted the New Republic about Fyyar's activities in the Remnant. Meanwhile, independent [[agent/Legends|operative]] [[Kyle Katarn]] raided the [[Empire Reborn base|Tatooine facility]] for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]; he left only one survivor, who later revealed to [[New Republic Intelligence Service|NRIS]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hantor Loftus]] all about Kejim.<ref name="NRIR">{{LucasArts|url=products/outcast/html/spin.html|text=N.R.I. Reports|int=N.R.I. Reports}}</ref> 

Tavion Axmis's presence in the [[Lenico system/Legends|Lenico system]] attracted the interest of Skywalker and a team of the Praxeum, who heard rujmors about a woman using Force powers for criminal gain; Skywalker did not make a connection but thought she might be recruited for his academy.<ref name="NRIR" /> 

Following Calrissian's vague reports about Cloud City, the [[Senator of Varonat]] relayed the curious elements to NRIS which sent an agent to Bespin; the investigator found no evidence of any disturbances, but was suspicious about Calrissian's connections. A short time later, information came from [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] about Reelo Baruk's company making a deal with Cloud City; the Intelligence found it curious, not only because of Baruk's criminal past, but also because the City never required garbage hauling before, as it was used for fuel.<ref name="NRIR" /> 

The loss of contact from [[Artus Prime]] also made the [[Senator of Bilbringi]] request a [[Supply_ship/Legends|supply ship]] to be sent with a communications crew. The ship disappeared when reaching the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and never returned.<ref name="NRIR" /> 

A weak signal coming from the defunct, as thought, [[Kejim Outpost]], was intercepted by the communications team of the NRIS. Despite days of attempts to decode it, the team managed to rescover only the fact that it was intended for Fyyar, proving that the Outpost was indeed used by the Empire Rebore. [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] asked to contact Katarn and [[Jan Ors]] with the request to brief them personally. The interrogated Reborn from Tatooine also mentioned Kejim as the origin of his orders. Eventually, decoded messages from Kejim to Fyyar made mention of the [[Valley of the Jedi]].<ref name="NRIR" /> 

Kyle Katarn and [[Jan Ors]] then were [[Mission to Kejim|sent]] to Kejim by Mon Mothma in order to investigate the information. They arrived on the ''[[Raven's Claw]]'', and while Ors remained in the control room to search the computer database for useful information, Katarn explored all three sections of the base and wiped out all the Imperial forces he encountered. Eventually he discovered that the base was used by the Empire Reborn as a laboratory for testing Artusian crystals. In the meantime, Fyyar and [[Desann]] discovered what happened, and Katarn's presence, through a security camera.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

[[File:Artusbat.jpg|thumb|left|A shootout between several prisoners and stormtroopers in the [[Battle of Artus Prime]].]]
The pair then were sent to Artus Prime to confirm the mining of crystals.
Katarn found himself in the [[Battle of Artus Prime]] where he released the prisoners from their cells, disabled the defenses to allow them escape, and the New Republic fleet to enter the system to evacuate them. The ''Claw'' also arrived, allowing Dessan and his apprentice [[Tavion Axmis]] to capture Ors. Katarn confronted the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who easily defeated him, and staged Ors's execution, then left leaving Katarn behind. The Republic fleet reclaimed the mining colony after bombarding it.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

[[File:Taviondesann.jpg|thumb|Axmis and [[Desann]], traveling to the [[Valley of the Jedi]].]]
However Ors's execution was only a pretext in order to tempt Katarn, and while he thought her dead, she was held captive in the ''[[Doomgiver]]''. Seeking revenge, Katarn traveled to [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] to reclaim his force powers from the [[Valley of the Jedi]] and avenge her; only to reveal its location to Desann, and empower the crystals with the forces of the [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Skirmish at the Valley of the Jedi|managed]] to scatter Desann and his troops, and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] chased away the Reborn ships. Skywalker eventually traced Desann to the Cairn Installation.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

===Personal revenge===
Fuelled now by his thirst for revenge, Katarn [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Empire Reborn)|returned]] to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to seek information on Desann. He discovered Reelo Baruk's role and also released [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and ''[[Lady Luck/Legends|Lady Luck]]'' from Baruk's hold. Having escaped, Katarn agreed to accompany Calrissian to Cloud City, which had been occupied by forces of the Empire Reborn and Baruk's minions, hoping to discover more clues to Desann's whereabouts.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

[[File:Batbes1.jpg|thumb|left|A [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] during the battle.]]
The ''Lady'' infiltrated the undercity and it was where Katarn first met and duelled with a Reborn Dark Jedi. The [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guards]] destroyed all of Reelo's thugs in the lower levels and then forced all Imperial forces out of the city. There Katarn met second time Jan's murderer, Tavion, whom he defeated; just then she revealed that she pretended to kill Kyle's partner in order to make him return to Ruusan; Ors was alive on Fyyar's ship, the ''[[Doomgiver]]'' in the [[Lenico Belt]].<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

[[File:LukeconfrontsDesann.jpg|thumb|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] confronts [[Desann]]]]
Katarn boarded an [[1-138|automated carrier]] to go to [[Cairn]] where the ''Doomgiver'' was docked and found Skywalker there looking for Desann. Together they [[Mission to Cairn Installation|infiltrated]] the facility before splitting. Katarn managed to sneak aboard the ''Doomgiver'' just as it was leaving. At the same time Skywalker fought a fierce duel against Desann, until the Dark Jedi buried Skywalker under rubble, and fled onto the ''Doomgiver''. However, Skywalker had managed to evade the rubble and could only watch the ''Doomgiver'' launch.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

===Epilogue at Yavin===
[[File:Doomgiver_Destroyed.jpg|thumb|left|The ''Doomgiver'' destroyed above Yavin.]]
Carrying an invading force composed of Reborn Dark Jedi and shadowtroopers, the ship headed for the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] in order to destroy the [[Jedi Praxeum]]. On board, Katarn alerted [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. While the imperial Strike Forces invaded the planet and stormed the Jedi Praxeum, Katarn proceeded with the rescue of Jan Ors, and eventually a confrontation with Galak Fyyar, operating a mechanical cortosis suit. The duel resulted in Fyyar's cortosis suit exploding, killing him, and Katarn disabling the ''Doomgiver''{{'s}} [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]]. With the shields down, Rogue Squadron was easily able to destroy the ''Doomgiver'' after Kyle and Jan escaped in [[escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. The New Republic infantry managed to defeat the forces that had time to land, although the Reborn managed to reach [[Great_Temple/Legends|the Temple]], engaging against the Jedi, both trainers and [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|initiates]].<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

Katarn hunted Desann throughout the Praxeum and the Temple's underground tunnels. Once more Desann tried to corrupt Katarn, who in turn invited him to redeem himself and return to the Order. Both rejecting each other, they duelled; all the while New the Republic infantry and the Jedi managed to rout the remaining stormtroopers and Reborn, Katarn also emerged victorious from the duel. The battle clearly lost and with their leaders dead, the surviving Reborn forces surrendered.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Empire Reborn campaign first appears in the [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast demo|''Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast'' demo]] where Katarn and Ors encounter Reborn in a [[Alzoc III Base|base]] on [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]]. However there are elements in that demo that create continuity errors, such as Katarn's lightsaber and Force powers as well as Ors's presence, making difficult to locate [[Mission at Alzoc III (Empire Reborn)|that mission]] in the history of the campaign.
